issue: धूम्र विलोचन नैना निशदिन मदमाती: read as the demon Dhūmravilocana (Dhūmralocana), slain, carrying on from विदारे / घाती, then 'your eyes are ever flushed'; it can also be read 'your smoke-dark eyes are ever flushed'.
our reading: the slayer of Dhūmravilocana too; your eyes are night and day flushed with fervour
alternatives: your smoke-dark eyes are night and day flushed

issue: श्रीमालकेतु में राजत कोटि रतन ज्योति: श्रीमालकेतु is not found in the dictionaries; kept as a name (a seat of the Mother).
our reading: In Śrīmālaketu shines the light of millions of gems
alternatives: श्री मालकेतु read as a banner (केतु) of Śrī rather than a place: 'on Śrī's banner shines …' (shlokam.org gives both, the reading uncertain)
